# `auth` — `/api/auth`

Accounts and sign-in: the host's first account (with the installer's setup code), joining by invitation, sessions kept in a cookie, password changes and host-given reset codes, and the Grove-wide roles the other routers check: the host, Grove owners and managers, webmasters, and members.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/auth/login`](#post-api-auth-login) | Anyone | Signs in with email and password, setting the session cookie. |
| POST | [`/api/auth/logout`](#post-api-auth-logout) | Anyone | Signs out: ends this session and clears its cookie. |
| GET | [`/api/auth/me`](#get-api-auth-me) | Member | The signed-in person: name, email, roles, what they may do, and Public chat's settings. |
| POST | [`/api/auth/password`](#post-api-auth-password) | Member | Changes the password. |
| POST | [`/api/auth/password/reset`](#post-api-auth-password-reset) | Anyone | Sets a new password with a reset code from the host. |
| POST | [`/api/auth/signup`](#post-api-auth-signup) | Anyone | Creates an account and signs in. |
| GET | [`/api/auth/status`](#get-api-auth-status) | Anyone | Whether the Grove still needs its host account (and a setup code), how passwords are recovered, and its public address. |

<a id="post-api-auth-login"></a>
### `POST /api/auth/login`

Signs in with email and password, setting the session cookie.

- Handler: [`login`](../../../backend/community/auth.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `Credentials`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes |  | at least 3 characters; at most 254 characters |
| `password` | string | yes |  | at least 12 characters; at most 256 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with the fields of a row of `users`: `id`, `name`, `email`, `admin`, `role`, `webmaster`, `can_start_spaces`, `host_tools`, `public_chat`, `log_name`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Email or password is incorrect. | `login` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 429 | Try again in 15 minutes. | `count_use` |

<a id="post-api-auth-logout"></a>
### `POST /api/auth/logout`

Signs out: ends this session and clears its cookie.

- Handler: [`logout`](../../../backend/community/auth.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `ok`

<a id="get-api-auth-me"></a>
### `GET /api/auth/me`

The signed-in person: name, email, roles, what they may do, and Public chat's settings.

- Handler: [`me`](../../../backend/community/auth.py)
- Who may call: Any signed-in member

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with the fields of a row of `users`: `id`, `name`, `email`, `admin`, `role`, `webmaster`, `can_start_spaces`, `host_tools`, `public_chat`, `log_name`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |

<a id="post-api-auth-password"></a>
### `POST /api/auth/password`

Changes the password. Every other session ends; this one is renewed.

- Handler: [`change_password`](../../../backend/community/auth.py)
- Who may call: Any signed-in member

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `PasswordChange`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `current` | string | yes |  | at most 256 characters |
| `password` | string | yes |  | at least 12 characters; at most 256 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `ok`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Current password is incorrect. | `change_password` |
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 429 | Try again in 15 minutes. | `count_use` |

<a id="post-api-auth-password-reset"></a>
### `POST /api/auth/password/reset`

Sets a new password with a reset code from the host. Every session ends.

- Handler: [`reset_password`](../../../backend/community/auth.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `PasswordReset`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 128 characters |
| `password` | string | yes |  | at least 12 characters; at most 256 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `ok`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Reset code expired or unavailable. Ask the host for a new code. | `reset_password` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 429 | Try again in 15 minutes. | `count_use` |

<a id="post-api-auth-signup"></a>
### `POST /api/auth/signup`

Creates an account and signs in. The first account is the host's and needs the setup code; any other needs an invitation or a space's public link.

- Handler: [`signup`](../../../backend/community/auth.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `Signup`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes |  | at least 3 characters; at most 254 characters |
| `password` | string | yes |  | at least 12 characters; at most 256 characters |
| `name` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `space` | string | no | `"My Grove"` | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `invite` | string | no | `""` | at most 128 characters |
| `setup_code` | string | no | `""` | at most 128 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with the fields of a row of `users`: `id`, `name`, `email`, `admin`, `role`, `webmaster`, `can_start_spaces`, `host_tools`, `public_chat`, `log_name`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Invite expired or unavailable. | `signup` |
| 403 | Enter the setup code the installer printed. | `signup` |
| 409 | This email is already registered. | `signup` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 429 | Try again in 15 minutes. | `count_use` |

<a id="get-api-auth-status"></a>
### `GET /api/auth/status`

Whether the Grove still needs its host account (and a setup code), how passwords are recovered, and its public address. Needs no sign-in.

- Handler: [`status`](../../../backend/community/auth.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `setup`, `setup_code`, `recovery`, `public_url`
